BETWEEN THE SHELVES

Follow your curiosity.

There is no right way to look around.

W A S D / arrows · walk   Drag or Q / E · turn   C · crouchMove the circle to walk.
Drag the room to look.
Pull below center to turn around.

Drag the circle in any direction to walk. Move farther from the center to walk faster. Pull below the center to turn around; return above it to face forward again. Lift your finger to stop. Use another finger on the room to look. With a keyboard, use the arrow keys. You can also choose places from Look around.

On touch screens, drag the movement circle in any direction; push farther out to walk faster. Pull below its center to turn around, and lift your finger to stop. Drag the room with your other hand to look. With a keyboard, walk with W A S D or the arrow keys; Q and E turn, and R and F look up or down. Hold Shift to walk faster or C to crouch. Click clear floor to walk there. Turning or walking away leaves an object naturally. Every place is also reachable with Tab and Enter.
